title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta2

## Stable retained trail and authenticated OpenStreetMap underlay

This beta turns the temporary vendor/MQTT field-test view into the normal retained-trail presentation and fixes OpenStreetMap underlay requests that can be blocked when embedded directly from the public tile service.

### Stable vendor backbone + MQTT live tail

- Remove the fixed red source-debug presentation and return to the configured mowing/trail color.
- Treat `trail_segments` as the integration-trimmed MQTT **tail**, not as the retained vendor backbone.
- Keep the last good server tail sticky within the same mowing session so a transient lightweight Map API refresh cannot make the browser fall back to the full local MQTT session.
- Append browser-live MQTT points only after a spatial match to the server tail's newest anchor.
- If that anchor cannot be matched, keep the server tail only instead of resurrecting old browser-local MQTT geometry.
- Reset the sticky tail when the integration's trail session changes.

Together with Navimower 0.4.5-beta6, retained vendor geometry is authoritative per zone while MQTT remains only the live/fallback source where vendor geometry is not available.

### OpenStreetMap

- Stop generating direct `tile.openstreetmap.org` SVG image requests.
- Replace direct tile URLs with local tile markers and hydrate them through the authenticated Navimower Map API binary path.
- Reuse Home Assistant's authenticated binary request helpers and revoke stale object URLs when map tiles are replaced.
- Preserve the normal OpenStreetMap attribution and existing map-underlay selector.

### Compatibility

- **Navimower 0.4.5-beta6 is recommended and required for the new OpenStreetMap proxy path.**
- Older integrations still retain the previous trail fallback behavior, but OpenStreetMap should be used after upgrading the integration to beta6.
- History, Multi mower, Estonia orthophoto/hybrid, Google Satellite, Gate areas and scheduler behavior remain unchanged.
